A patient's copula log densities at every grid point

Source: R/conditionalDesignCopula.R
copula_logdens_grid.Rd

Shared by conditionalYTCopula(), conditionalYDTCopula(), conditionalYTBioCopula() and conditionalYDTBioCopula(). The patient's covariance, observed values and threshold bounds do not depend on the event time, so the design (build_conditional_design_copula()) is built once per candidate value of the predicted biomarker instead of once per grid point, and the means at all grid points come from copula_mean_grid(). The densities are then evaluated in the same order as before – grid point, candidate value, event type 1 then 0 – so the Monte Carlo draws of mvtnorm::pmvnorm() are the same.

Usage

copula_logdens_grid(
  data_num_i_list,
  rep_num_i_list,
  long_fit_all,
  l_i,
  survival_variable,
  time_variable,
  survival_variable_all,
  survival_trans_function,
  sigma.longitudinal,
  event_type_variable = NULL,
  bio = NULL
)

Arguments

data_num_i_list, rep_num_i_list

The patient's rows per biomarker.

sigma.longitudinal

Residual SDs (1 for an ordinal biomarker).

event_type_variable

NULL without competing risks; otherwise the event-type column, evaluated at 1 and at 0.

bio

NULL, or a list with index, name, row and values: the predicted biomarker, its response column, the row of the predicted measurement and its candidate values.

Value

A list with one element per event type (1, then 0; just one without competing risks), each a length(l_i) x (number of candidate values, 1 without bio) matrix of log densities.
